subject: SIG intake: Finexus initial questionnaire and proposed section routing
messages:
From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@finexus.com>

Cc: security@finexus.com
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request — Finexus initial questionnaire

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the conversation earlier. Finexus is moving toward vendor intake next week and we'd like to get Redwood's SIG completed for our procurement review. Attached is the SIG spreadsheet with our baseline questions — please confirm who on your side will own each section and when we can expect the first-pass answers plus any evidence artifacts.

High level ask:
- First-pass responses to all SIG questions by 2026-07-27
- Artifact list (e.g., policy docs, screenshots, SOC/attestation references) by 2026-07-30

Can you also confirm whether Redwood has a single evidence manifest we can use, or if you prefer us to consume artifacts per-section? HubSpot deal id is FINX-4821.

Thanks,
Evan Liu
Security Program Manager
Finexus

Attachments: Finexus_SIG_questions.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42 tabs)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@finexus.com>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — Finexus initial questionnaire

Evan — thanks for sending this over and for the clear timeline. Looping in our internal SIG leads so we can split ownership and surface any evidence gaps early. Proposed routing below is our working plan; please review and flag anything that should be moved around.

Proposed section owners (first pass):
- Section 1.0/Network & Perimeter: Diego Fernandez (diego_fernandez@redwood.ai)
- Section 2.0/Identity & Access Management: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.ai)
- Section 3.0/Asset Inventory & Configuration: Jonas Weber (jonas_weber@redwood.ai)
- Section 4.0/Change Management & Deployment Controls: Irene Choi (irene_choi@redwood.ai)
- Crypto, Key Management, and any vendor-hosted encryption details: Tessa Morgan (me)

Evidence lanes: we plan to provide a centralized evidence manifest (attached template) that lists artifact filename, section mapping, owner, and access instructions. For large exports (audit logs, config dumps) we will provide short access instructions in the manifest and produce a secure link instead of attaching large files.

Request to the Finexus team: if you have section-level priorities, call them out and we will prioritize those pages first. Otherwise, we will triage by perceived buyer risk (Identity, Network, Change management first).

Deliverable dates (internal):
- Owners confirm assignments: by 2026-07-19 EOD PT
- First-pass SIG complete draft: 2026-07-26 (internal review 7/27)
- Evidence manifest populated / links shared: 2026-07-30

Attachments: evidence_manifest_template.csv (small CSV)

Diego / Marissa / Irene / Jonas — please reply to confirm your sections and call out any blockers (access to logs, policy versions, or SOC references). I will act as the SME coordinator and handle upload + link sharing.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Security Programs
Redwood Inference
